annotations.title: Run on your own numbers (get access)

description: Get the link to run a real close on your OWN numbers — bring a rebate / SPA / deduction extract and get back audit-defensible accruals, full lineage, and an auditor-ready export, with nothing posted to your GL. Use this when the user is ready to move from a sample to their own data. Optionally takes a work email to set up access — only what the user volunteers, and never ask for financial data inside the chat.

email.description: Optional work email to set up access / follow up. Only pass what the user volunteers.

scenario.description: Optional short description of what the user wants to run.

name: request_real_run
